written: 2026-11-18, after the first evaluation and before the review fixes ran on any model. Held out: not to be used to tune the check or the wording.

grading.invents: Fail: the reply says or takes for granted that a person, a named place, a settlement, a building, a shop or a pet exists in the buddy's own world when the buddy has not met it (not in its memory or what it knows of its land), or answers as if a presupposed neighbour, town or family were real.
grading.over_refuses: Fail (controls only): the reply denies or ignores the person's own people and places, treats them as the buddy's own, or refuses to engage.
grading.own_world: Pass: what it says about itself and its land matches what it remembers (its name, the places it knows, what it did).
grading.shared_history: Fail: the reply says it remembers something the person told, showed or brought it when it has no memory of that.
